tests.title: Tickets are listed by priority, oldest first
An agent can't take more tickets than their limit
Tickets move through the workflow in order
A ticket is overdue only after its SLA
Filters by status, priority and assignee
Resolving records when; reopening clears it
Finished tickets are never overdue and don't count toward a limit

bugs.why: the workload counts only open tickets, so tickets already in progress don't count toward the agent's limit
bugs.fix: Count every unfinished ticket assigned to the agent: status open or in_progress.

edits.fixed: private static final Set<String> ACTIVE = Set.of("open", "in_progress");
edits.buggy: private static final Set<String> ACTIVE = Set.of("open");

bugs.why: the time open is worked out in minutes, not hours, so tickets look overdue far too early
bugs.fix: Divide the seconds by Times.SECONDS_PER_HOUR (60 * 60) to get hours.

bugs.why: tickets with the same priority are listed newest first; the queue must serve the oldest first
bugs.fix: Compare createdAt in natural (ascending) order as the tie-breaker after priority.

bugs.why: the workflow lets an in-progress ticket jump straight to closed, skipping resolved
bugs.fix: From in_progress the only next status is resolved.
